funded_clean.subject: Context: Northwind Analytics Series A
funded_clean.body:
Priya,

You closed a Series A of $8M and have 12 open engineering roles.

Companies at this stage often find shipping speed limited by how fast recruiting can keep up rather than by ambition.

Would a brief call next week make sense to explore how Acme Engineering's dedicated teams could help you ship faster than in-house hiring alone allows?

Sam
Research Partner
